summary: conduyt-auth register takes a required --terms-accepted flag that sends termsAccepted true (POST /auth/register requires it). The command takes no positional arguments (pflag reads `--terms-accepted false` as the bare flag plus a stray "false"; that spelling is refused locally, nothing sent). Without the flag (or with --terms-accepted=false) the command refuses locally, naming the Terms and Privacy Policy, and sends nothing; --stdin passes the body through untouched (reads cmd.InOrStdin()).
reason: The live POST /auth/register answers 400 to any body without termsAccepted true, so a reprint from the old spec would drop the flag and every CLI registration would fail. spec.yaml carries the typed requestBody for this one operation only; the parity test pins spec.yaml, tools-manifest.json and the command to the same typed body.
validated_outcome: With --terms-accepted the wire body carries termsAccepted true; without it (or =false) no request is sent and the error names the terms; any positional argument is refused before RunE with no request; spec.yaml, tools-manifest.json and the command flags agree on the required const-true boolean; go build, go vet and the focused internal/cli tests pass. Ported from the creator's private print (ptaramona/conduyt-crm-cli 917ee77, PR #2, Codex approved).
